input.goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo: index.html + scene.js + engine3d.js + app.js, using a custom software 3D renderer (no WebGL, no external libraries) drawing on a full-viewport 2D <canvas id="c">.
constraints: index.html loads engine3d.js, scene.js, app.js via plain <script> tags in that order; no modules, no CDN, works from file://
Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> sized to window.innerWidth x innerHeight with devicePixelRatio, resized on window resize; body margin 0, overflow hidden
Background each frame: dark radial gradient space, center #1a0b3a fading to #05020f at edges
engine3d.js: vec3 math, perspective projection, camera lookAt, back-face culling, painter's algorithm depth sort, flat shading with a directional light, filled polygons with neon edge stroke
scene.js: two-tier platform (lower wide box + upper smaller box), twin pillars, a lintel across pillar tops, a crown cap on the lintel: exactly 6 boxes = 36 box faces (quads)
Six octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) orbiting the portal, each spinning, cyan/magenta neon colors
Portal core between the pillars: glowing center disc plus two concentric rings rotating in opposite directions (ring colors #00f0ff and #ff2bd6)
Cyber grid floor: neon purple/cyan lines on the ground plane projected in 3D, fading with distance
Exactly 180 stars in the background that twinkle (per-star sine alpha)
Exactly 110 particles rising from the portal/platform, respawning at the bottom when they reach max height
Orbiting camera circling the portal at constant radius, looking at the portal center; orbit can be toggled
Glassmorphism HUD panel top-left: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter blur(12px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.2), border-radius 14px, white text
HUD title text exactly: NEON PORTAL 3D
HUD stats lines with ids fps, polys, parts showing labels exactly 'FPS:', 'POLYS:', 'PARTS:' followed by live numbers (PARTS shows 110)
Three buttons with ids btnPause, btnOrbit, btnReset; labels exactly 'Pause' (toggles to 'Resume' when paused), 'Orbit ON' (toggles to 'Orbit OFF'), 'Reset'
Speed slider <input type=range id=speed min=0 max=3 step=0.1 value=1> labelled 'Speed', scales animation speed
Reset restores camera angle to 0, speed slider to 1, unpaused, orbit on
Expose window.app = { paused, orbit, speed, camAngle, stars, particles, crystals, polyCount, fps } kept up to date each frame (stars.length 180, particles.length 110, crystals.length 6)

I used Tandem to build the neon portal demo, and it passed all its checks. It's four files: `index.html`, `engine3d.js`, `scene.js` and `app.js`. Everything else you listed is there, including the HUD with the buttons and speed slider. The HUD shows 84 polygons (36 box faces plus 48 crystal triangles) and 110 particles. Open `index.html` in a browser to run it; it needs no WebGL or outside libraries.

In the rendered screenshot, the magenta portal ring is mostly hidden behind the pillars and the cyan ring, so only small arcs of it show. If you want both rings clearly visible, that's a quick follow-up.
